name: Integration connections and status
summary: Connecting a user's Procore or Autodesk account, linking a Track3D project to a Procore, Autodesk or Fieldwire project, and the status Track3D shows for each connection.

requirements.title: Link a Track3D project to a Procore project
requirements.statement: A user signed in with Procore can link a Track3D project to a Procore project and then sees the Procore project ID on the project details page. A user who isn't signed in to Procore is asked to sign in first.

open_checks: Procore and Autodesk sign-in methods are covered by USER-REQ-007 and DEC-011; this requirement covers only project linking

acceptance_criteria.given: A user signed in with Procore on a project's details page
acceptance_criteria.when: They choose Link Project to Procore and pick a Procore project
acceptance_criteria.then: The project is linked and the Procore project ID shows on the details page

acceptance_criteria.given: A user who hasn't signed in with Procore
acceptance_criteria.when: They try to link the project to Procore
acceptance_criteria.then: They are asked to sign in with Procore first

requirements.title: Integration status is several independent flags
requirements.statement: For Procore and Autodesk, Track3D reports separately whether the user is signed in, whether the project is linked, and whether the linked company or hub is one the user can still see. Fieldwire reports signed in and linked. Signed in does not mean linked, and none of the flags means data is syncing.
open_checks: All three platform calls run together, so one failing platform fails the whole status call. Autodesk 'custom integration' is true whenever the user sees any hub

acceptance_criteria.given: A user signed in with Procore whose project is not linked to Procore
acceptance_criteria.when: They open the project's integration status
acceptance_criteria.then: Procore shows signed in, not linked and not company-mapped

acceptance_criteria.given: A linked Procore project whose stored company is not in the user's current Procore company list
acceptance_criteria.then: Procore shows linked but not company-mapped

requirements.title: A project links to one account per platform
requirements.statement: A project that is already linked to Procore or Fieldwire can't be linked again until it is unlinked. Procore and Autodesk links can be removed; there is no Fieldwire unlink, which the PRD puts out of scope.

requirements.title: Procore and Autodesk connect per user, Fieldwire per project
requirements.statement: A Procore or Autodesk connection belongs to the user who signed in, and calls to those platforms use that user's own access. A Fieldwire connection belongs to the project, through the API key saved on it. Automatic Procore design updates use the access of the user who imported the design.
